title: Core additive equivalence for Veronese fractions
statement: For a scheme X, an invertible module L, a natural number d, and a homogeneous section s of degree d, the type of additive equivalences from HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val to SectionFractionPresentation (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d) is nonempty. This is the core equivalence assertion; the generator formula is stated separately.

source.place: Equation module-invert-s (Tag 0B5L), Lemma 01PW(2), and the Veronese localization in the proof of Lemma 01Q1

proof.text: Use the existing constructed sectionRingVeroneseFractionEquiv X L d s as the witness of Nonempty.

proof_origin.place: Reuse the existing explicit sectionRingVeroneseFractionEquiv from SectionRingVeroneseFractionsFormula as the Nonempty witness. Its construction uses the proved fraction-map surjectivity and the existing unresolved sectionRingVeroneseFractionMap_kernel; no duplicate kernel calculation is introduced.

theorem sectionRing_veronese_fraction_core
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) :
    Nonempty (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val ≃+
      SectionFractionPresentation (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d))
